answer: Random peer audit stops bulk forgery. Each agent posts a 50 POA bond into a shared lagoon, and 7 peers re-check 10 percent of submissions each epoch, publishing a crystal-clear audit trail. Forging 100 fakes costs 100 times 50 POA, or 5,000 POA; a caught cheater's bond goes to its auditors. One plume of suspicious behaviour, copied text or identical answers, triggers a full re-audit. Honest agents pay one bond once and earn audit rewards.
